Il pasto dei butteri e dei carbonai mare: The meal of the Maremma butteri (cowherds) and charcoal burners. It is a dish of the area (Maremma): here it is listed under the provincial capital, Grosseto.

Trasferirlo nello stampo e livellarlo co: Transfer it to the tin and level it with wet hands, 2 cm thick.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 755: very ripe strawberries, orange and lemon juice, quantities for eight people. Emanuele Rossi gives it in the «Vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), no. 645.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 22: the cappelletti mixture of recipe 7 (ricotta, capon breast cooked in butter, parmesan, eggs, nutmeg and lemon zest) is taken and, instead of being closed in pasta, dropped by the teaspoonful into the boiling broth.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 252: the recipe was sent to him by a lady who ordered him not to call it stiacciata: «la chiami pizza a libretti e sarà nel vero» (call it pizza a libretti and you will be right).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipes 205 and 206: two ways of making golden chicken, the first floured, left for half an hour in egg, breadcrumbed and browned in oil or «meglio lardo vergine» (better, fresh lard), the second only floured, dipped in egg and fried, always with lemon wedges.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 263: young chicken studded with tufts of ramerino and pieces of garlic, browned in a battutino of lardone, cooked with tomatoes and broth, with potato wedges as a side.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 264: chicken in large pieces browned with a battutino of onion and butter, cooked with broth, then put back on the heat with the strained sauce and a little marsala, «levandolo appena abbia ripreso il bollore» (taking it off as soon as it has come back to the boil).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 265: whole chicken on a battuto of onion, butter and slices of prosciutto, coloured, moistened with broth or water and cooked over a slow heat with three or four sausages «fatte di fresco» (freshly made).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 267: the young chicken is brought two thirds of the way to doneness on the spit, divided at the joints and finished in a sauce of onion, 50 grams of butter, 10 of flour and three decilitres of cream (or very good milk).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 539: «non è un ripieno da cucina fine, ma da famiglia» (it is not a stuffing for fine cooking, but for the family): sausages, the chicken's giblets, eight or ten roast chestnuts, truffles or dried mushrooms, an egg and a bread paste; for a turkey the quantities are doubled.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 656: 500 grams of prunes simmered gently for half an hour with red wine, water, a small glass of marsala, 100 grams of sugar and cinnamon; «un dolce che si conserva a lungo» (a sweet that keeps a long time). Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 671: a bread pudding «battezzato» (christened) Cesarino, with 200 grams of crumb, Malaga raisins and sultanas, milk, marsala and rum, cooked for three hours in a bain-marie in the caramelised mould and served «caldo e in fiamme» (hot and flaming); it serves ten or twelve people.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 536: mock quails made with the stuffed bracioline of no. 307 or with a wrapping of milk-fed veal, wrapped in lardone, tied crosswise and roasted on the spit each between two crostini with sage, basted with broth.

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 612: it is made like the quattro quarti (pound cake) of no. 611 (eggs and, at their weight, sugar and flour, with 200 grams of butter), but the candied peel and raisins are replaced by lemon peel and 100 grams of sweet almonds with a few bitter ones; «un dolce squisito» (an exquisite cake).

Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 503: the simplest way to stew frogs is a soffritto of oil, garlic and parsley, salt and pepper, and lemon juice at the end; «alcuni, invece del limone, usano il sugo di pomodoro, ma il primo è da preferirsi» (some use tomato sauce instead of lemon, but the former is preferable).

Tritarle grosse come mezzo chicco di ris: Chop them to the size of half a grain of rice.
Mescolare le mandorle e lo zucchero a ve: Mix the almonds and icing sugar with the flour and make a well.
Mettere al centro il burro e lo strutto: Put the soft butter and lard, the egg and the yolk in the middle and knead quickly, working as little as possible.
Formare una palla e lasciarla riposare 2: Shape a ball and leave it to rest for 2 hours in the fridge, covered.
Accendere il forno a 180 °C e ungere una: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a baking tray with the cold butter for the tray.
Tirare la pasta con il matterello liscio: Roll out the dough with the smooth rolling pin and then with the ridged one, to a little under 1 cm.
Ritagliare le pastine con un tagliapasta: Cut out the biscuits with a round cutter: it makes about 50.
Disporle nella teglia e cuocerle 15 minu: Arrange them on the tray and bake them for 15 minutes, until just golden.
Lasciarle raffreddare e servirle; si con: Leave them to cool and serve; they keep for 2 weeks in a tin.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 594: little biscuits of flour, sugar, toasted almonds, butter and lard, rolled first with the smooth rolling pin and then with the ridged one and cut out with the disc: it makes about 50.
Accendere il forno statico a 180 °C; imb: Heat a conventional oven to 180 °C; butter a rectangular baking tin with the butter for the tin and dust it with the flour for the tin.
Separare le uova e lavorare i tuorli con: Separate the eggs and work the yolks with the sugar for 15 minutes, until pale and puffed up.
Montare gli albumi a neve ferma e unirli: Whisk the whites to stiff peaks and fold them gently into the yolks, from the bottom upwards.
Far cadere la farina da un colino, mesco: Sift in the flour, folding slowly.
Stendere il composto nella teglia a mezz: Spread the mixture in the tin half a finger thick and bake it for 12-15 minutes, until golden and springy.
Rovesciarlo ancora caldo su un canovacci: Turn it out while still hot onto a tea towel and moisten it with the rosolio.
Spalmarlo di marmellata di albicocche e: Spread it with apricot jam and cover it with the candied fruit cut into thin slices.
Arrotolarlo stretto su sé stesso e lasci: Roll it up tightly on itself and leave it to cool, closed in the tea towel, for 1 hour.
Sciogliere il cioccolato fondente a bagn: Melt the dark chocolate in a bain-marie and spread it over the roll.
Lasciarlo rapprendere 30 minuti, tagliar: Leave it to set for 30 minutes, cut it into slices and serve; it keeps for 3 days in the fridge.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 618: salame inglese, which «si potrebbe più propriamente chiamare pan di Spagna ripieno» (could more properly be called stuffed sponge cake), is made handsome with strips moistened with rosolio, alkermes and chocolate rosolio in a chequerboard; this is the version «per uso di famiglia» (for family use), with fruit preserve, candied fruit and a chocolate crust.
Aprire le salsicce fresche a metà per il: Split the fresh sausages in half lengthways.
Metterle in un tegame senza grassi, con: Put them in a pan without fat, cut side down; if they are lean add the butter.
Cuocerle a fuoco medio 10 minuti, girand: Cook them over a medium heat for 10 minutes, turning them halfway, until browned and cooked.
Rompere le uova nel tegame tra le salsic: Break the eggs into the pan between the sausages, one for each sausage.
Salare appena le uova e cuocerle 3-4 min: Lightly salt the eggs and cook them for 3-4 minutes over a low heat, covered, until the white has set.
Servire subito nel tegame; non si conser: Serve at once in the pan; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 243: fresh sausage split lengthways and cooked without fat, with the eggs broken over it, «una lega che piace a molti» (a pairing many people like); with diced carnesecca a piece of butter is added and the eggs are whisked first.
Lavare le sarde, togliere la testa e apr: Wash the sardines, remove the heads and open them from the belly with your fingers to take out the backbone.
Ammollare la mollica di pane nel latte 5: Soak the breadcrumb in the milk for 5 minutes and squeeze it.
Pulire le acciughe salate da squame e li: Clean the salted anchovies of scales and bones.
Separare l'uovo e tritare finissimi moll: Separate the egg and very finely chop the breadcrumb, anchovies, yolk, garlic and oregano, finishing with the knife blade.
Spalmare il ripieno sulle sarde e richiu: Spread the filling on the sardines and close them up.
Sbattere l'albume, passarvi le sarde una: Beat the white, dip the sardines in it one at a time and then in the breadcrumbs.
Scaldare l'olio a 170 °C e friggerle 3-4: Heat the oil to 170 °C and fry them for 3-4 minutes, until golden.
Scolarle su carta, salarle appena e serv: Drain them on paper, salt them lightly and serve them hot with lemon wedges; they do not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 483: 20 to 24 sardines «delle più grosse» (of the largest) spread with a mixture of breadcrumb, anchovies, egg yolk, garlic and regamo (oregano), dipped in egg white and breadcrumbs and fried in oil, with lemon wedges.
Togliere al cavolo bianco le foglie verd: Remove the green leaves from the white cabbage, cut it into four wedges and wash it.
Affettarlo per traverso a filetti sottil: Slice it crossways into strips as thin as taglierini.
Metterlo in una terrina con il sale e co: Put it in a bowl with the salt and cover it with the boiling water; leave it until cold, about 1 hour.
Strizzarlo bene e rimetterlo nella terri: Squeeze it well and put it back in the bowl with the strong wine vinegar mixed with fresh water.
Lasciarlo 3 ore, poi strizzarlo di nuovo: Leave it for 3 hours, then squeeze it again.
Tritare fine il prosciutto crudo e soffr: Finely chop the prosciutto and fry it in the butter for 3 minutes in a casserole.
Unire il cavolo e cuocerlo a fuoco basso: Add the cabbage and cook it over a low heat for 1 hour, moistening it with the ready-made meat broth.
Assaggiare: l'aceto deve sentirsi appena: Taste: the vinegar should be barely noticeable; adjust the salt.
Servire caldo con cotechino, zampone o l: Serve hot with cotechino, zampone or boiled meat; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipes 432 and 433: «non è questo il vero sauer-kraut, il quale bisogna lasciar fare ai tedeschi» (this is not true sauerkraut, which must be left to the Germans), but a pale imitation that goes well with coteghini, zamponi and boiled meat; in the second version the white cabbage in strips is stewed with carnesecca and onion and finished with vinegar and a teaspoon of sugar.
Tagliare la fesa di vitello a fettine di: Cut the veal topside into 5 mm slices and beat them with the meat mallet to 3 mm.
Passarle nella farina, scuotendo via que: Dip them in the flour, shaking off the excess.
In una padella larga sciogliere il burro: In a wide frying pan melt the butter over a medium heat and put in the slices in a single layer.
Condire con sale e pepe e cuocerle a fuo: Season with salt and pepper and cook them over a gentle heat for 4-5 minutes per side, until golden.
Versare la panna acida e scuotere la pad: Pour in the sour cream and shake the pan so that it coats the meat.
Aggiungere il brodo di carne pronto e cu: Add the ready-made meat broth and cook for another 5 minutes, until the sauce coats the spoon.
Servire subito con la salsa e gli spicch: Serve at once with the sauce and the lemon wedges on the side; they keep in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 305: soured cream, he writes, «non nuoce anzi migliora il piatto che riesce delicatissimo» (does no harm, indeed improves the dish, which turns out most delicate); quantities for four, 500 g of lean meat and two decilitres of cream.
Rifilare i bordi delle fette di lingua s: Trim the edges of the slices of salted tongue to give them a regular shape and keep the trimmings aside.
Ritagliare dal prosciutto cotto 10 fetti: Cut 10 slices of cooked ham the size of the tongue slices and keep the trimmings aside.
Nel mortaio o nel mixer ridurre a crema: In the mortar or food processor reduce the tongue and ham trimmings to a cream with the soft butter and the white truffle.
Spalmare la crema su un lato delle fette: Spread the cream on one side of the tongue slices and lay the slices of ham on top.
Per la gelatina: ammollare la gelatina i: For the jelly: soak the leaf gelatine in cold water for 10 minutes, heat the ready-made skimmed meat broth without letting it boil, dissolve the squeezed leaves in it and leave it to cool slightly.
Versare in un piatto largo uno strato di: Pour a 3 mm layer of jelly into a wide dish and let it set in the fridge for 15 minutes.
Disporre le scaloppe sulla gelatina, cop: Arrange the escalopes on the jelly, cover them with the remaining jelly and leave to set in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Staccare le scaloppe una a una col colte: Cut out the escalopes one by one with the knife and serve them cold; they keep in the fridge for 2 days, covered.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 362: «fra i rifreddi questo è uno dei migliori e di bella apparenza» (among cold dishes this is one of the best and handsomest); ten escalopes which, at a dinner of several courses, serve eight people.
Tagliare il lardo a bastoncini e passarl: Cut the lard into sticks and roll them in salt and pepper.
Bucare il magatello di manzo con un colt: Pierce the beef silverside with a small knife and push the sticks of lard into the cuts.
Salare la carne e legarla con lo spago p: Salt the meat and tie it with string so that it stays compact.
Tagliare a pezzetti le carote e il sedan: Cut the carrots and celery into small pieces and put them on the bottom of a narrow casserole.
Appoggiarvi la carne e coprirla con l'ac: Lay the meat on top and cover it with the water.
Cuocere coperto a fuoco basso 2 ore, fin: Cook covered over a low heat for 2 hours, until the water has almost all been absorbed.
Togliere la carne, passare al passaverdu: Take out the meat, pass the vegetables and their juices through the food mill and put everything back in the casserole with the dry white wine.
Cuocere altri 20-30 minuti, finché la ca: Cook for another 20-30 minutes, until the meat is tender to the fork and the sauce is thick.
Servire a fette col suo intinto sopra; s: Serve in slices with its sauce on top; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 301: «non sapendo come chiamare quest'umido semplice e sano, gli ho dato il titolo di scannello annegato» (not knowing what to call this simple, wholesome stew, I have given it the title of drowned scannello); quantities for six people.
Accendere il forno a 200 °C (oppure prep: Heat the oven to 200 °C (or prepare the spit).
Tagliare il tartufo bianco a bastoncini: Cut the white truffle into sticks 3 cm long and the butter into small pieces.
Fare dei piccoli tagli nella lombata di: Make small cuts in the beef loin with the point of a thin knife.
Infilare in ogni taglio un bastoncino di: Push a stick of truffle into each cut and close it with a small piece of butter.
Incidere il grasso di copertura con tagl: Score the covering fat with crosswise cuts so that the meat does not shrink, then tie it with string.
Arrostire allo spiedo o in forno 45 minu: Roast on the spit or in the oven for 45 minutes, turning it halfway.
Ungerla con l'olio extravergine di oliva: Brush it with the extra virgin olive oil, salt it lightly and roast for another 20-25 minutes, until the inside reaches 55-58 °C (pink).
Lasciarla riposare 10 minuti coperta, af: Leave it to rest for 10 minutes, covered, slice it and serve it with its juices; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 523: «i macellari di Firenze chiamano sfilettato la lombata di manzo o di vitella a cui sia stato levato il filetto» (the butchers of Florence call sfilettato the loin of beef or veal from which the fillet has been removed).
Per la pasta sfoglia: impastare la farin: For the puff pastry: knead the flour with the cold water and salt, shape a block and leave it to rest for 20 minutes in the fridge.
Stenderlo in un rettangolo, mettere al c: Roll it out into a rectangle, put the cold butter, beaten into a slab, in the middle, close it in and roll out; fold in three, turn a quarter and repeat 4 times, with 15 minutes in the fridge every two turns.
Per il marzapane: tritare finissime le m: For the marzipan: very finely grind the blanched almonds with the sugar and bind them with the egg white into a soft paste.
Stendere la pasta sfoglia a 3-4 mm e rit: Roll the puff pastry out to 3-4 mm and cut out two 24 cm discs, with large scallops round the edge.
Stendere il marzapane su un disco, alto: Spread the marzipan on one disc, 1 cm thick, leaving a 2 cm border free.
Coprire con l'altro disco e sigillare i: Cover with the other disc and seal the edges with a finger dipped in water.
Spennellare la superficie col tuorlo e c: Brush the top with the yolk and bake for 30-35 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Lasciar intiepidire, spolverizzare di zu: Leave to cool slightly, dust with icing sugar and serve; it keeps for 2 days under a cake dome.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 566: the quantities serve seven or eight people and, he writes, «sentirete che questo dolce sarà molto lodato per la sua delicatezza» (you will hear this sweet much praised for its delicacy).
Impastare 75 g di farina col lievito di: Knead 75 g of flour with the brewer's yeast and 4 spoonfuls of lukewarm fresh cream, shape a little ball and leave it to rise for 30 minutes, until doubled.
Lavorare col cucchiaio di legno in una c: With a wooden spoon, work the remaining flour in a bowl with 70 g of melted butter, the yolks, the salt, the risen ball and enough of the remaining cream for a soft dough, until it comes away from the sides.
Coprire e far lievitare 1 ora e mezza in: Cover and leave to rise for 1 1/2 hours in a warm place.
Rovesciare la pasta sulla spianatoia inf: Turn the dough out onto the floured pastry board, spread it with your hands to 5 mm and cut it into strips.
Imburrare e infarinare uno stampo a ciam: Butter and flour a 1.5-litre ring mould and arrange the strips in layers, brushing each layer with the remaining 30 g of melted butter.
Coprire e far lievitare ancora 45 minuti: Cover and leave to rise for another 45 minutes, until it reaches the rim; meanwhile heat the oven to 180 °C.
Cuocere 35-40 minuti, finché è dorato e: Bake for 35-40 minutes, until golden and it sounds hollow.
Per il ripieno: pulire e affettare i fun: For the filling: clean and slice the mushrooms, cook them for 15 minutes in a frying pan with the extra virgin olive oil and garlic, then add the tomato passata, salt, pepper and chopped parsley and cook for another 5 minutes.
Sformare la ciambella, riempire il buco: Turn out the ring, fill the hole with the hot mushrooms and serve; it is eaten the same day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 344: the sformato of leavened dough «serve come di pane per mangiare con esso il suo contenuto, che può essere un umido qualunque di carne o di funghi» (serves as bread to eat its contents with, which can be any stew of meat or mushrooms).
Per la besciamella: sciogliere il burro,: For the béchamel: melt the butter, add the flour and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the hot milk in a thin stream, stirring with the whisk, and cook for 5 minutes over a low heat, until it coats the spoon.
Togliere dal fuoco, unire il groviera gr: Take off the heat, add the grated gruyère and salt.
Quando non bolle più, separare le uova e: When it has stopped bubbling, separate the eggs and add the yolks one at a time and then the whites whisked to stiff peaks, folding from the bottom upwards.
Imburrare uno stampo a ciambella da 1,5: Butter a 1.5-litre ring mould and dust it with breadcrumbs.
Versarvi il composto e cuocere 35-40 min: Pour in the mixture and bake for 35-40 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Per il ripieno: pulire e tagliare a pezz: For the filling: clean and cut the chicken giblets and sweetbreads into small pieces, brown them in the butter for 5 minutes with salt and pepper and cook them for 15 minutes with the ready-made meat broth.
Sformare sul piatto, riempire il buco co: Turn out onto the plate, fill the hole with the hot filling and serve at once; it is eaten as soon as it is made.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 346: «la bella e gentilissima signora Adele desidera vi faccia conoscere questo suo sformato di gusto assai delicato» (the lovely and most kind signora Adele wishes me to introduce you to this sformato of hers, of very delicate taste); it serves six.
Togliere ai cardi le foglie e i fili, ta: Remove the leaves and strings from the cardoons, cut them into 2 cm pieces and keep them in water with the juice of the half lemon.
Lessarli in acqua salata 20 minuti, finc: Boil them in salted water for 20 minutes, until almost tender, and drain them.
Rosolarli con 30 g di burro a fuoco medi: Brown them with 30 g of butter over a medium heat for 5 minutes, then finish them for 10 minutes with 100 ml of milk.
Per la besciamella: sciogliere il burro: For the béchamel: melt the remaining butter, add the flour, cook for 1 minute and pour in the remaining milk in a thin stream, stirring for 5 minutes until it thickens.
Unire ai cardi la besciamella, le uova s: Add the béchamel, beaten eggs and grated parmesan to the cardoons, then taste and adjust the salt.
Accendere il forno a 170 °C e foderare u: Turn the oven on to 170 °C and line a smooth 1 litre mould with buttered baking paper.
Versarvi il composto e cuocere a bagnoma: Pour in the mixture and cook in a bain-marie for 45 minutes, until firm.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 389: it is made like the cauliflower sformato, cutting the cardoon into small pieces «onde vengano penetrati bene dal condimento» (so that the dressing gets well into them).
Pestare o frullare gli amaretti fino a r: Pound or blend the amaretti to a powder.
In una casseruola mescolare lo zucchero: In a saucepan mix the sugar and potato starch and pour in the cold milk gradually, stirring.
Unire gli amaretti e cuocere a fuoco med: Add the amaretti and cook over a medium heat for 5-6 minutes, stirring, until the cream thickens.
Togliere dal fuoco e, quando è tiepida,: Take off the heat and, when it is warm, add the yolks of the 3 eggs and then the whites whisked to stiff peaks.
Accendere il forno statico a 170 °C, imb: Heat a conventional oven to 170 °C, butter a ring mould with the cold butter and pour in the mixture.
Cuocere 35-40 minuti, finché è sodo e do: Bake for 35-40 minutes, until firm and golden.
Per lo zabaione: montare i tuorli con lo: For the zabaione: whisk the yolks with the sugar and marsala in a bain-marie for 8-10 minutes, until puffed and creamy.
Sformare il dolce, riempirlo e coprirlo: Turn out the pudding, fill it and cover it with the zabaione and serve; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 651: amaretti, sugar and potato flour cooked in milk, lightened with whisked whites and covered with the zabaione of recipe 684.
Tagliare a filetti le mandorle pelate e: Cut the blanched almonds into slivers and toast them in a frying pan for 3 minutes; halve the shelled pistachios and dice the candied citron.
Sciogliere a fuoco basso il cioccolato f: Melt the dark chocolate in 100 ml of milk over a low heat, then add the sugar and butter and set aside.
In un tegame stemperare la farina di cas: In a pan mix the chestnut flour with the remaining milk poured in a little at a time, so that it does not form lumps.
Unire il cioccolato e cuocere a fuoco me: Add the chocolate and cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring, until it is a thick cream; leave it to cool.
Separare le uova, unire i tuorli, poi gl: Separate the eggs, add the yolks, then the whites whisked to stiff peaks and finally the almonds, pistachios and citron.
Accendere il forno statico a 170 °C, ung: Heat a conventional oven to 170 °C, grease a ring mould with the cold butter and pour in the mixture.
Cuocere a bagnomaria in forno 45 minuti,: Cook in a bain-marie in the oven for 45 minutes, until firm.
Lasciar raffreddare e poi tenere in frig: Leave to cool and then keep in the fridge for at least 4 hours (Artusi froze it in ice with salt).
Montare la panna fresca con lo zucchero: Whip the fresh cream with the vanilla sugar.
Sformare, riempire il buco con la panna: Turn out, fill the hole with the whipped cream and serve cold; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 652: the recipe was sent to him by «un signore di Barga di onorevole casato» (a gentleman of Barga of honourable family); farina dolce, he explains, is chestnut flour.
Ungere bene col burro freddo uno stampo: Grease a fluted pudding mould well with the cold butter.
Pour the rosolio into a deep plate.
Intingere velocemente i savoiardi nel ro: Quickly dip the savoiardi in the rosolio, on one side only, and line the bottom and sides of the mould with them.
Spalmare sui savoiardi uno strato di con: Spread a layer of fruit preserve over the savoiardi.
Continuare a strati di savoiardi bagnati: Carry on with layers of moistened savoiardi and alternating preserves up to the rim, finishing with savoiardi.
Coprire e lasciar riposare in frigo alme: Cover and leave to rest in the fridge for at least 4 hours, so that the pudding firms up.
Immergere lo stampo per 5 secondi nell'a: Dip the mould for 5 seconds in boiling water, so the butter melts, and turn it out onto the plate.
Servire a fette; si conserva in frigo 2: Serve in slices; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 680: savoiardi or sponge cake dipped in rosolio and fruit preserves, left for a few hours so that the mixture «si compenetri» (melds together), with no custard at all.
Togliere i semi all'uva malaga, ammollar: Remove the seeds from the Malaga raisins, soak both kinds of raisins in lukewarm water for 10 minutes and dice the candied citron.
Ungere col burro freddo uno stampo a cia: Grease a ring mould with the cold butter.
Intingere appena i savoiardi nel marsala: Barely dip the savoiardi in the marsala and arrange them in layers in the mould, alternating with the squeezed raisins and the candied peel.
Per la crema: sbattere le uova con lo zu: For the custard: beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla sugar and add the cold milk.
Accendere il forno statico a 170 °C e ve: Heat a conventional oven to 170 °C and pour the raw custard over the savoiardi.
Cuocere a bagnomaria in forno 40 minuti,: Cook in a bain-marie in the oven for 40 minutes, until the custard has set.
Per lo zabaione: montare con la frusta l: For the zabaione: whisk the eggs, sugar and marsala in a bowl over a pan of simmering water for 8-10 minutes, until puffed up.
Sformare caldo, riempire il buco con lo: Turn out while hot, fill the hole with the zabaione so that it overflows, and serve; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 684: the zabaione must fill the hole «traboccante» (overflowing), so that it covers the whole pudding; it serves six people and «è un dolce che piace» (it is a sweet people like).
Stemperare la farina di mais fine con 10: Mix the fine maize flour with 100 ml of cold milk.
Portare a bollore il latte rimasto e ver: Bring the remaining milk to the boil and pour in the mixed flour, stirring with the whisk.
Cuocere 5 minuti a fuoco basso, finché è: Cook for 5 minutes over a low heat, until it is a soft polentina.
Togliere dal fuoco e unire il burro, lo: Take off the heat and add the butter, sugar and salt; leave to cool.
Separare le uova, unire alla polentina 3: Separate the eggs, add 3 yolks one at a time to the polentina and then the 6 whites whisked very stiff, folding gently (the extra yolks are for another recipe).
Accendere il forno statico a 190 °C, imb: Heat a conventional oven to 190 °C, butter a baking dish and dust it with the flour.
Versarvi il composto e cuocere 25-30 min: Pour in the mixture and bake for 25-30 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Portarlo in tavola subito nella pirofila: Bring it to the table at once in the dish, before it falls.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 682, who introduces it in verse: «Questo piatto i francesi lo chiaman soufflet… Io sgonfiotto, se date il permesso» (The French call this dish soufflet… I'll call it sgonfiotto, by your leave). Quantities for six people.
Pulire le sogliole: svuotarle, togliere: Clean the soles: gut them, remove the scales, wash and dry them well.
Sciogliere metà del lardo in un tegamino: Melt half the lard in a small pan over a low heat and set it aside.
Spalmare le sogliole col lardo rimasto,: Spread the soles with the remaining cold lard and season them with salt and pepper.
Coat them in the breadcrumbs, pressing well.
Scaldare la griglia a fuoco medio-alto p: Heat the grill over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Cuocere le sogliole 5-6 minuti per lato,: Cook the soles for 5-6 minutes per side, brushing them with the melted lard, also when turning them, until the flesh comes away from the bone.

Sformarlo caldo e servirlo subito; in fr: Turn it out hot and serve it at once; in the fridge it keeps for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 279: timballo, «forse dalla forma che si approssima all'istrumento musicale» (perhaps from its shape, which resembles the musical instrument), with two pigeons and 300 grams of maccheroni in a shortcrust case, for ten or twelve people «se non sono forti mangiatori» (if they are not big eaters).
Immergere le tinche in acqua bollente pe: Plunge the tench into boiling water for 2-3 minutes, until the skin begins to crack, then cool them in iced water: this removes the muddy smell.
Tagliare pinne, testa e coda, aprire le: Cut off the fins, head and tail, open the tench along the back and remove the backbone and bones.
Divide them lengthways into two fillets.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Passare i filetti nella farina, poi nell: Dip the fillets in the flour, then in the egg and breadcrumbs, then again in the egg and breadcrumbs.
Cuocere i filetti 3-4 minuti per lato, f: Cook the fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Servirli subito con il limone a spicchi;: Serve them at once with the lemon wedges; they do not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 501: at the Florence market tench are sold alive; they are boned, breadcrumbed twice and cooked in the sauté pan with butter, and to remove the marshy smell they are first scalded in boiling water.
Pulire le tinche, staccare le teste e ta: Clean the tench, remove the heads and cut them into small pieces; cut the fins and tail from the bodies, leaving them whole.
Tritare cipolla, aglio, prezzemolo, seda: Chop the onion, garlic, parsley, celery and carrot and fry them in 3 spoonfuls of oil over a medium heat for 5 minutes.
Aggiungere le teste con sale e pepe e cu: Add the heads with salt and pepper and cook them for 10 minutes.
Versare la passata di pomodoro sciolta n: Pour in the tomato passata dissolved in the water and cook for 15 minutes, then press the sauce through a sieve.
In un tegame scaldare il resto dell'olio: In a pan heat the rest of the oil, lay in the tench and season with salt and pepper.
Cuocerle 20 minuti a fuoco basso, versan: Cook them for 20 minutes over a low heat, pouring in the sauce a little at a time.
Intanto lessare le bietole 5 minuti, str: Meanwhile boil the chard for 5 minutes, squeeze it and let it take on flavour for 5 minutes in the tench sauce.
Servire le tinche con le bietole intorno: Serve the tench with the chard around them; in the fridge they keep for a day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 517: the tench are brought to doneness with the sauce made from their heads and tomato; «per dare al zimino il suo vero carattere ci vuole un contorno d'erbaggi» (to give the zimino its true character a side of greens is needed), chard or spinach.
Chop the garlic and parsley together.
In un tegame largo scaldare l'olio a fuo: In a wide pan heat the oil over a medium heat and fry the chopped mixture for 2 minutes, until the garlic begins to turn golden.
Mettere le fette di tonno fresco, salarl: Put in the slices of fresh tuna, season with salt and pepper and cook them for 3 minutes per side.
Versare la passata di pomodoro allungata: Pour in the tomato passata thinned with the water and cook over a low heat for 10 minutes, covered.
Togliere il tonno dal tegame e tenerlo i: Take the tuna out of the pan and keep it warm on a covered plate.
Nel sugo rimasto mettere i piselli fresc: In the remaining sauce put the fresh peas, salt and cook covered over a low heat for 15 minutes, until tender.
Rimettere il tonno sopra i piselli e sca: Put the tuna back on top of the peas and heat it for 3 minutes.
Servire il tonno caldo col suo contorno: Serve the tuna hot with its side of peas; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day, covered.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 473: Artusi recommends the belly of the tuna, «che in Toscana chiamasi sorra» (which in Tuscany is called sorra), cooked in the soffritto with tomato and served on the peas cooked in its sauce.
Accendere la griglia o scaldare una bist: Light the grill or heat a griddle pan over a fierce heat for 10 minutes.
Ungere le fette di ventresca di tonno co: Brush the slices of tuna belly with the oil on both sides.
Season them with salt and pepper.
Passarle nel pangrattato, premendo perch: Coat them in the breadcrumbs, pressing so that they stick well.
Cuocerle sulla griglia 3-4 minuti per la: Cook them on the grill for 3-4 minutes per side, until the crust is golden and the inside just pink.
Servire subito il tonno con gli spicchi: Serve the tuna at once with the lemon wedges; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 474: «tagliatelo a fette come il precedente, ma preferite la sorra» (cut it into slices like the previous one, but choose the sorra), that is the belly; dressed with oil, salt and pepper, coated in breadcrumbs and served with lemon wedges.
Tagliare il magro di vitello di latte in: Cut the lean milk-fed veal into 6 thin slices, beat them with the meat mallet and trim them, keeping the trimmings aside.
Pulire le acciughe dal sale e dalla lisc: Clean the salt and bones from the anchovies.
Tritare finissimi i ritagli di carne con: Very finely chop the meat trimmings with the chicken livers, 30 g of lard, the juniper berries, the anchovies and 2 sage leaves; season with a little salt and pepper.
Spalmare il ripieno sulle fette, arrotol: Spread the stuffing on the slices, roll them up, wrap them in the remaining slices of lard with half a sage leaf underneath and tie them crosswise with string.
In una casseruola scoperta scaldare l'ol: In an uncovered casserole heat the oil over a fierce heat and brown the mock thrushes for 8 minutes, turning them, with a little more salt and pepper.
Scolare l'unto lasciando il fondo brucia: Pour off the fat, leaving the browned bits in the casserole.
Bagnare con il brodo di carne un mestoli: Moisten with the meat broth a small ladle at a time and cook over a low heat for 25 minutes, until the sauce has almost dried up.
Tostare le fette di pane casalingo sulla: Toast the slices of home-made bread on the grill for 2-3 minutes per side, until crisp.
Slegare i tordi, posarli sulle fette di: Untie the thrushes, lay them on the slices of bread and pour over the reduced sauce; they are also good cold and keep in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 281: «tordi finti perchè li rammenta l'odore del ginepro» (mock thrushes because the scent of juniper recalls them); bracioline of milk-fed veal with chicken livers, anchovies and juniper, served on crostini of toasted bread, «buone anche diacce» (good cold too).
Frolla: impastare velocemente la farina: Shortcrust: quickly knead the flour with the sugar, the butter and lard in small pieces and the egg, into a smooth ball; wrap it and leave it to rest for 30 minutes in the fridge.
Crema: separare le 3 uova, tenendo da pa: Custard: separate the 3 eggs, keeping the whites aside; in a small pan beat the yolks with the sugar and flour, pour in the milk in a thin stream and add the split vanilla.
Cuocere la crema a fuoco basso 8 minuti,: Cook the custard over a low heat for 8 minutes, stirring all the time, until it coats the spoon; remove the vanilla and leave it to cool.
Accendere il forno statico a 170 °C e un: Heat a conventional oven to 170 °C and butter a cake tin.
Stendere due terzi della frolla a 4 mm e: Roll out two thirds of the shortcrust to 4 mm and line the base; with the rest make a border 3 cm high, sticking it on with a finger dipped in water.
Tagliare il pan di Spagna a fette di 5 m: Cut the sponge cake into 5 mm slices, moisten them lightly with the citron liqueur and cover the base with half the slices.
Stendere la crema e coprirla con le rest: Spread the custard and cover it with the remaining slices moistened with liqueur.
Montare a neve ben ferma 2 albumi e unir: Whisk 2 whites until very stiff and add the icing sugar gradually, keeping a spoonful back, to make a glossy meringue.
Coprire la torta con la meringa lasciand: Cover the tart with the meringue, leaving the shortcrust border free, which is brushed with the third beaten white.
Cuocere 40 minuti, coprendo con un fogli: Bake for 40 minutes, covering with a sheet of paper when the meringue is firm, so that it stays pale.
Sformarla fredda, spolverizzarla col cuc: Turn it out when cold, dust it with the spoonful of icing sugar kept aside and serve; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 581: shortcrust, sponge cake moistened with citron rosolio, custard and a topping of «marenga» (meringue); «coloro a cui non istucca il dolciume giudicheranno questo piatto squisito» (those who do not tire of sweetness will judge this dish exquisite).
Frolla: impastare la farina con il burro: Shortcrust: knead the flour with the butter in small pieces, the sugar, egg and marsala, working little, into a smooth ball; leave it to rest for 30 minutes in the fridge.
Tritare i pinoli col coltello in pezzett: Chop the pine nuts with a knife into pieces the size of half a grain of rice.
Portare a bollore il latte con il sale,: Bring the milk to the boil with the salt, pour in the semolina in a slow rain and cook for 10 minutes, stirring, until firm.
Fuori dal fuoco unire zucchero, pinoli,: Off the heat add the sugar, pine nuts, butter and vanillin; when lukewarm add the 2 eggs, mixing quickly.
Stendere due terzi della frolla a 3 mm e: Roll out two thirds of the shortcrust to 3 mm and line the base of the tin.
Versare il composto (non più alto di 3 c: Pour in the mixture (no more than 3 cm deep) and cover it with strips of the remaining shortcrust crossed into diamonds.
Spennellare la grata col tuorlo sbattuto: Brush the lattice with the beaten yolk and bake for 45 minutes, until golden.
Servirla fredda spolverizzata di zuccher: Serve it cold dusted with icing sugar; it keeps for 3 days in a cool place.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 582: «questa è una torta che alcuni pasticcieri vendono a ruba» (this is a tart some pastry cooks cannot make fast enough to sell); Artusi reproduces it with semolina, chopped pine nuts and a shortcrust lattice «a mandorle» (in diamonds).
Impastare la farina con 100 g di burro m: Knead the flour with 100 g of soft butter, the salt, the grated lemon zest and as much milk as needed, into a smooth, firm dough.
Avvolgerla e lasciarla riposare 30 minut: Wrap it and leave it to rest for 30 minutes.
Stendere la pasta a 4 mm, foderare il fo: Roll the pastry out to 4 mm, line the base and make a border all round with the trimmings.
Sbucciare le mele renette, togliere il t: Peel the rennet apples, remove the cores and cut them into walnut-sized chunks.
Spread the apples over the pastry.
Mescolare lo zucchero con la cannella e: Mix the sugar with the cinnamon and scatter it over the apples, then drizzle with the melted butter.
Cuocere 45 minuti, finché la pasta è dor: Bake for 45 minutes, until the pastry is golden and the apples tender.
Servirla calda o fredda per 7-8 persone;: Serve it hot or cold for 7-8 people; it keeps for 2 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 583: «sia o non sia svizzera, io ve la do per tale» (Swiss or not, I give it to you as such); the cinnamon, lemon zest and melted butter over the apples are, Artusi writes, his own additions.
Accendere il forno statico a 170 °C, imb: Heat a conventional oven to 170 °C, butter a cake tin and sprinkle it with breadcrumbs.
Pestare nel mortaio o tritare al mixer i: Pound in the mortar or grind in the food processor the walnut kernels with the sugar, into a fine flour.
Versare in una terrina e unire il ciocco: Pour into a bowl and add the grated dark chocolate and the vanillin.
Separare le uova e aggiungere i tuorli u: Separate the eggs and add the yolks one at a time, stirring.
Chop the candied citron very finely.
Montare a neve gli albumi e incorporarli: Whisk the whites to stiff peaks and fold them in with a light hand, then add the candied peel.
Versare nella teglia (alto non più) e cu: Pour into the tin (not too deep) and bake for 40 minutes at a moderate heat, until a cocktail stick comes out dry.
Servirla fredda; si conserva 4 giorni so: Serve it cold; it keeps for 4 days under a cake dome.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 637: walnuts, chocolate and whisked eggs baked in the oven at a moderate heat; «dai miei commensali questo è stato giudicato un dolce squisito» (my guests judged this an exquisite cake).
Sbucciare la zucca gialla, togliere semi: Peel the yellow pumpkin, remove the seeds and fibres and grate it onto a tea towel.
Chiudere il canovaccio e strizzare forte: Close the tea towel and squeeze the pumpkin hard: from 1 kg about 300 g will remain.
Cuocerla nel latte a fuoco basso 25-40 m: Cook it in the milk over a low heat for 25-40 minutes, stirring, until broken down and thick.
Pestare le mandorle pelate con lo zucche: Pound the blanched almonds with the sugar to a fine powder.
Fuori dal fuoco unire alla zucca mandorl: Off the heat add the almonds, butter, breadcrumbs, salt and cinnamon to the pumpkin; leave to cool, then add the beaten eggs.
Pasta matta: impastare la farina con l'a: Pasta matta: knead the flour with the water and a pinch of salt for 5 minutes and roll it out very thin, 1-2 mm.
Accendere il forno statico a 160 °C, ung: Heat a conventional oven to 160 °C, grease a cake tin with the lard and line it with the pasta matta.
Versare il composto alto circa 3 cm e cu: Pour in the mixture about 3 cm deep and bake for 50 minutes at a moderate heat, covering with a sheet of paper if it darkens.
Servirla fredda tagliata a rombi; si con: Serve it cold cut into diamonds; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 640: «questa torta si fa d'autunno o d'inverno, quando la zucca gialla si trova in vendita dagli ortolani» (this tart is made in autumn or winter, when yellow pumpkin is on sale at the greengrocers'); it is baked like the ricotta tart no. 639, on a thin layer of pasta matta.
Pestare finissime le mandorle pelate con: Pound the blanched almonds very finely with the sugar, added a spoonful at a time.
Portare a bollore il latte, versare il s: Bring the milk to the boil, pour in the fine semolina in a slow rain and cook for 10 minutes over a low heat, stirring.
Prima di togliere dal fuoco unire il bur: Before taking off the heat add the butter and the almonds with the sugar, which melt at once.
Salare, grattugiare la scorza del limone: Salt, grate in the lemon zest and leave to cool slightly.
Accendere il forno statico a 180 °C, imb: Turn the conventional oven on to 180 °C, butter a baking tin and dust it with breadcrumbs.
Sbattere a parte le uova e incorporarle: Separately beat the eggs and work them into the warm semolina.
Versare nella teglia, alto 3-4 cm, e cuo: Pour into the tin, 3-4 cm deep, and bake for 45 minutes, until the top is golden.
Sformarla fredda e servirla intera o tag: Turn it out when cold and serve it whole or cut into diamonds; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 643: semolina cooked in milk with pounded almonds and lemon zest, poured into a tin «alta un dito e mezzo o al più due» (a finger and a half or at most two deep) and served «tagliata a mandorle» (cut into diamonds).
Squamare le triglie, togliere le interio: Scale the red mullet, remove the innards through the gills with the point of a knife, wash and dry them.
Mettere nel ventre di ognuna un pezzetto: Put a small piece of garlic in the belly of each.
Condirle con sale, pepe, l'olio e gli ag: Season them with salt, pepper, the oil and the rosemary needles and leave them to rest for 30 minutes.
Scaldare la griglia a fuoco vivo per 10: Heat the grill over a fierce heat for 10 minutes.
Passare le triglie nel pangrattato e cuo: Coat the mullet in the breadcrumbs and cook them for 4-5 minutes per side, brushing them with their dressing.
Servire le triglie calde con gli spicchi: Serve the mullet hot with the lemon wedges; they do not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 469: red mullet flavoured with garlic, oil and ramerino and cooked on the grill breadcrumbed, or «così naturali a fuoco ardente» (plain like that over a fierce heat) and dressed only afterwards; they are served with lemon wedges.
Scottare i ventrigli 10 minuti nel brodo: Scald the gizzards for 10 minutes in the broth (if you have none, salted water), clean off the tough skin and cut them in three; keep the liquid aside.
Pulire le creste e i fegatini di pollo e: Clean the cockscombs and chicken livers and cut the livers in two.
Tagliare le coste del sedano a bastoncin: Cut the celery sticks into 5 cm batons and boil them for 8 minutes in salted water, then drain them.
Tritare fini il prosciutto crudo e la ci: Finely chop the prosciutto and onion and fry them in the butter for 5 minutes over a medium heat.
Unire i ventrigli e la fecola di patate,: Add the gizzards and the potato starch, stir, then add the livers and cockscombs.
Condire con sale, pepe e noce moscata e: Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg and brown for 5 minutes.
Bagnare con la passata di pomodoro e un: Moisten with the tomato passata and a ladle of the gizzard liquid and cook for 15 minutes over a low heat.
In una padella a parte rosolare il sedan: In a separate frying pan brown the celery in the butter for the celery for 8 minutes, until soft.
Unire le rigaglie al sedano e far bollir: Add the giblets to the celery and simmer together for 5 minutes, adding liquid if it dries out.
Servire caldo; si conserva in frigo 1 gi: Serve hot; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 352: giblets made «più gentili» (more refined) with only the chicken livers, cockscombs and gizzards scalded in broth, in a battutino of prosciutto and onion with a pinch of potato flour, combined with the celery fried separately in butter.
Tirare fuori le uova dal frigo 30 minuti: Take the eggs out of the fridge 30 minutes beforehand, so that the shells do not crack in the hot water.
Portare a bollore 1 litro di acqua in un: Bring 1 litre of water to the boil in a small pan.
Calare le uova una alla volta con un cuc: Lower the eggs in one at a time with a spoon, reduce to a gentle boil and time them from when they go into the water.
Uova a bere: 2-3 minuti, con la chiara a: Soft-boiled eggs: 2-3 minutes, with the white just set and the yolk runny.
Uova bazzotte: 6-7 minuti, col tuorlo cr: Medium-boiled eggs: 6-7 minutes, with the yolk creamy in the centre.
Uova sode: 9-10 minuti, col tuorlo sodo: Hard-boiled eggs: 9-10 minutes, with the yolk firm but still bright yellow.
Appena pronte passarle in acqua fredda p: As soon as they are ready put them in cold water for 2 minutes, so that they stop cooking and peel easily.
Servire quelle a bere nel portauovo, rom: Serve the soft-boiled ones in egg cups, breaking the top, with a pinch of salt; the hard-boiled ones peeled and halved, with salad or a sauce; hard-boiled eggs keep in the fridge for 3 days in their shells.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 139: two minutes for soft-boiled eggs, six or seven for medium, ten for hard, counting from when they go into the boiling water, and then straight into cold water. The same times, with small differences, in E. Rossi, «La vera cuciniera genovese» (1865), nos. 538-539, and in G. Lazzari-Turco, «Il piccolo focolare» (1921), nos. 5.2, 5.3 and 5.9.
Portare a bollore l'acqua in una pentola: Bring the water to the boil in a wide pot with the white wine vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Rompere ogni uovo in una tazzina, senza: Break each egg into a small cup, without breaking the yolk.
Abbassare a bollore leggero, girare l'ac: Reduce to a gentle boil, swirl the water with the spoon and slide in one egg at a time from a low height.
Cuocere 3-4 minuti, finché la chiara è r: Cook for 3-4 minutes, until the white has set and the yolk no longer wobbles but stays soft.
Intanto sciogliere il burro in un pentol: Meanwhile melt the butter in a small pan over a low heat.
Togliere le uova con la schiumarola, asc: Lift out the eggs with the skimmer, dry them briefly on a tea towel and put them on the hot plate.
Condire con sale, pepe, il burro fuso e: Season with salt, pepper, the melted butter and the grated parmesan.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 140: eggs dropped into boiling water and dressed with salt, pepper, cheese and butter, or with tomato sauce, or served on purée or spinach. E. Rossi (1865, no. 540) adds a dusting of cinnamon; G. Lazzari-Turco (1921, no. 5.7) puts vinegar in the water and brings them to the table with tomato sauce.
Rassodare le uova 9 minuti in acqua boll: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes in boiling water, cool them in cold water and peel them.
Tagliarle a metà per il lungo e togliere: Cut them in half lengthways and remove the yolks.
Lavare le acciughe dal sale, togliere la: Wash the salt off the anchovies, remove the backbone and chop them with the parsley and the slice of onion.
Schiacciare i tuorli con la forchetta, u: Mash the yolks with a fork, add the chopped mixture and the soft butter and work with the blade of a knife into a smooth cream.
Riempire le mezze chiare con la crema, c: Fill the half whites with the cream, heaping it up, and arrange them on a serving dish.
Maionese: nel tuorlo a temperatura ambie: Mayonnaise: into the room-temperature yolk, with a pinch of salt, pour the seed oil in a thin stream, whisking for 5 minutes, then thin with the lemon juice.
Cover the eggs with the mayonnaise.
Servire fredde; si conservano in frigo 1: Serve cold; they keep in the fridge for 1 day, covered.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 143: one anchovy for every two eggs, chopped with parsley and very little onion, worked with the yolks and butter, and the mayonnaise on top; «si possono mangiare anche semplicemente condite con sale, pepe, olio e aceto, chè non sono da disprezzarsi» (they can also be eaten simply dressed with salt, pepper, oil and vinegar, for they are not to be scorned).
Separate the yolks from the whites.
Scaldare il latte in una casseruola larg: Heat the milk in a wide saucepan with the split vanilla pod, to a gentle simmer.
Montare gli albumi a neve ben ferma con: Whisk the whites with the salt until very stiff and, still whisking, add the icing sugar.
Con un cucchiaio da tavola prendere dei: With a tablespoon take egg-shaped puffs of white and drop them into the simmering milk, a few at a time.
Cuocerli 1 minuto per parte, girandoli,: Cook them for 1 minute per side, turning them, until firm, and drain them with the skimmer onto a sieve.
Filtrare il latte e lasciarlo intiepidir: Strain the milk and leave it to cool slightly.
Sbattere i tuorli con lo zucchero, versa: Beat the yolks with the sugar, pour in the milk and cook the custard over a low heat for 10 minutes, stirring without letting it boil, until it coats the spoon.
Lasciar raffreddare la crema, versarla i: Leave the custard to cool, pour it into a serving dish and arrange the snow eggs on top, one on another.
Servire freddo; si conserva in frigo 1 g: Serve cold; it keeps in the fridge for 1 day.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 691: the «fiocca» (snow) of whites whisked and sweetened with icing sugar, taken up with the spoon in the shape of an egg and firmed in boiling milk; with the milk, yolks and sugar the vainiglia (vanilla) custard is made. «Questa dose può bastare per otto o dieci persone» (These quantities may serve eight or ten people).
Usare solo un uovo freschissimo, tenuto: Use only a very fresh egg, kept in the fridge, because it is eaten raw.
Separate the yolk from the white.
In una tazza larga sbattere il tuorlo co: In a wide cup beat the yolk with the sugar for 3-4 minutes, with a teaspoon or a small whisk, until pale and foamy.
In un'altra ciotola montare l'albume a n: In another bowl whisk the white until very stiff, 2-3 minutes with the whisk.
Unire l'albume al tuorlo mescolando pian: Fold the white into the yolk gently from the bottom upwards, so that it does not collapse.
Tagliare il pane a fettine lunghe da int: Cut the bread into long thin slices for dipping.
Servire subito la tazza con le fettine d: Serve the cup at once with the slices of bread; it does not keep.
Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina: Pellegrino Artusi, «La scienza in cucina e l'arte di mangiar bene» (1891), recipe 719, «Un uovo per un bambino» (An egg for a child): the yolk beaten with two or three teaspoons of sugar and the white whisked stiff, with slices of bread to dip, «colle quali si farà i baffi gialli e lo vedrete contentissimo» (with which he will give himself a yellow moustache, and you will see him delighted).
Battere appena la sottonoce di vitello e: Lightly beat the veal topside and tie it with string so that it keeps its shape.
Tagliare la pancetta a fette sottilissim: Cut the pancetta into very thin slices and cover the bottom of a casserole with the pancetta and the butter.
Sbucciare il limone al vivo, togliere i: Peel the lemon to the flesh, remove the seeds, cut 4 thin slices and lay them on the pancetta.

Piatto di casa delle campagne toscane, d: A home dish of the Tuscan countryside, where almost every family had a vegetable garden and cavolo nero was the vegetable grown with most care: it is said that only frost softens it.

C'è chi bagna la carne con vino bianco p: Some moisten the meat with white wine before the broth, some keep the hare overnight in vinegar or salted wine to remove the gaminess, and some make a light dolceforte of just vinegar and sugar; the same method is used for salt cod.

Dolce del Rione Santa Lucia, uno dei bor: The sweet of the Rione Santa Lucia, one of the historic quarters of Castelnuovo di Garfagnana: the recipe passes from father to son and is made every 13 December only by the residents of the quarter. Despite the name, it has no almonds.

Servire le nozze con panna montata o cre: Serve the nozze with whipped cream or pastry cream; empty, they keep for a week in a tin.
Dolce antichissimo di Calcinaia, in prov: A very old sweet of Calcinaia, in the province of Pisa, made for weddings and christenings; every year in May, usually on the third Sunday, there is the sagra della Nozza. It is related to the brigidino of Lamporecchio.

Si cucina in Lunigiana fin dal Quattroce: It has been cooked in the Lunigiana since the fifteenth century; the name comes from the mixture pressed and beaten with the hands. The dry leaves of the chestnut, the «albero del pane» (bread tree), served as baking paper. It is a dish of the area (Lunigiana): here it is listed under the provincial capital, Massa.
Tagliare il baccalà già ammollato e diss: Cut the salt cod, already soaked and desalted, into regular pieces of about 5 cm.

Servire subito: è buona appena fatta, il: Serve at once: it is good just made; leftover broth keeps for a day in the fridge.
Piatto tipico di Rio Marina, all'isola d: A typical dish of Rio Marina, on the island of Elba: a humble salt cod soup, born in the homes of miners and fishermen.
Scaldare il latte appena tiepido e frull: Warm the milk until just lukewarm and blend it with the rum, the rosemary leaves, the grated orange zest, the sugar and the salt.

Leave the batter to rest for 15 minutes.

Versare la pastella a cucchiaiate, poche: Pour in the batter by the spoonful, a few at a time, and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until the fritters are puffed and dark.

Servirle calde; si mangiano subito, vuot: Serve them hot; they are eaten at once, and unfilled they keep for half a day.
Dolce di Antona, borgo di circa 300 abit: A sweet of Antona, a village of about 300 people in the Apuan Alps behind Massa, which in summer holds sagre and festivals for these neccio fritters.

Frullare la rucola con l'altro spicchio: Blend the rocket with the other garlic clove and 2 spoonfuls of water into a smooth sauce.

Spolverare con il pecorino grattugiato e: Sprinkle with the grated pecorino and serve at once; they do not keep.
Piatto della tradizione di Carrara, sull: A traditional dish of Carrara, on the Apuan Riviera: the «due sapori» (two flavours) are the sea of the shrimps and the land of the lard and rocket.
Mettere nel mixer la farina, l'uovo, la: Put the flour, egg, grated orange zest, sweet white wine and butter in small pieces in the food processor and work into a smooth, soft dough; wrap it and set it aside.

Lasciarlo raffreddare del tutto, tagliar: Leave it to cool completely, cut it into rounds and serve with vin santo; it keeps for 10 days wrapped in paper.
Pitigliano è la «piccola Gerusalemme» de: Pitigliano is the «little Jerusalem» of Tuscany: in the seventeenth century the Jews of Pitigliano, Sorano and Sovana were confined in the ghetto, and according to tradition the shape of the sweet recalls the sticks with which soldiers knocked on doors for the «sfratto» (eviction). It is made at Christmas.
Sgranare le fave, lavarle e tenerle da p: Shell the broad beans, wash them and set them aside.

Versare l'acqua calda, coprire e cuocere: Pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes over a medium heat, until the broad beans are tender.
Regolare di sale, mescolare e aggiungere: Adjust the salt, stir and add a drop of water if they dry out too much.
Spolverare con pepe nero e servire caldo: Sprinkle with black pepper and serve hot or warm; it keeps for 2 days in the fridge.
Contorno toscano di primavera, quando le: A Tuscan spring side dish, when broad beans are fresh; with more pancetta it becomes a main course.
Senza pancetta, con solo cipollotto e un: Without pancetta, with only spring onion and a tomato, it is the side dish for meatless days.

Piatto delle famiglie pratesi per il Mar: A dish of Prato families for Shrove Tuesday: it was the last indulgence before Lent. The pine nuts set them apart from other Tuscan meatballs.
Ogni famiglia ha la sua: c'è chi usa vit: Every family has its own: some use veal instead of beef and some serve them warmed through in the braising sauce.
Sciacquare il farro della Garfagnana e c: Rinse the Garfagnana spelt and cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for about 30 minutes, until tender; drain it well and leave it to cool slightly.

Versare il composto e livellarlo; ripieg: Pour in the mixture and level it; fold the edge of the pastry over the filling.
Cuocere 45 minuti, finché la superficie: Bake for 45 minutes, until the top is golden brown.
Lasciarla raffreddare prima di tagliarla: Leave it to cool before cutting and serve it with cured meats and cheeses; it keeps for 3 days in the fridge.
Si prepara da secoli in Garfagnana con i: It has been made for centuries in the Garfagnana with spelt grown between 300 and 1000 metres without chemical fertilisers, now IGP; it is a tart of the valley's shops and trattorie. Esiste anche la versione dolce, con farr: There is also a sweet version, with spelt cooked in milk, sugar and candied fruit.
Pulire i totani e i calamari e tagliarli: Clean the flying squid and squid and cut them into rings; rinse the prawns, the king prawns and the monkfish steaks.

Zuppa povera nata sulla spiaggia dell'Ar: A humble soup born on the beach of the Argentario: the fishermen cooked it on returning from fishing in the «caldaro», the pot that gives it its name. The fish changes with the season and the fishing closures.
Pulire i pesci, togliere le interiora, s: Clean the fish, remove the innards, skin the smooth-hound and the scorpion fish and cut everything into pieces; cut the cuttlefish and octopus into strips.

A Viareggio il cacciucco si faceva a bor: In Viareggio cacciucco was made aboard the fishing boats with the fish that did not sell; today it is made again with the «pesce dimenticato» (forgotten fish) of Versilia (horse mackerel, barracuda, flying fish, bluefish). Si distingue da quello livornese per il: It differs from the Livorno one in the Versilia fish and in the bread put to soak in the pot.
Setacciare la farina di castagne in una: Sift the chestnut flour into a bowl with the salt.

Servirli caldi con la ricotta, oppure co: Serve them hot with ricotta, or with honey or cured meats; they are eaten as soon as they are made.
Sono i protagonisti delle castagnate dom: They are the stars of the Sunday chestnut feasts of the Lunigiana, in the village squares and the chestnut woods. It is a dish of the area (Lunigiana): here it is listed under the provincial capital, Massa.
Dolci con ricotta, crema di nocciole o m: Sweet with ricotta, hazelnut spread or honey; savoury with cured meats and cheeses.

Dolcetti delle sagre e feste di paese to: Little sweets of the Tuscan sagre and village festivals: they are not chewed but left to melt in the mouth, and so they are said to be the ideal present for one's mother-in-law, who stays silent until she falls asleep.

Premere la superficie con la punta delle: Press the surface with your fingertips to make many small dimples.

D'estate si arricchisce con la frutta di: In summer it is enriched with seasonal fruit.

Aggiungere la pancetta fresca a pezzetti: Add the fresh pancetta in small pieces and brown it for 5 minutes without burning it.
Unire il farro sciacquato, farlo tostare: Add the rinsed spelt, toast it for 2 minutes, cover with 1.5 litres of water, salt and bring to the boil.

D'estate la «minestra del Vinciano» è un: In summer the «minestra del Vinciano» is a soup of lettuces, chard, escarole, borage and watercress, scalded and added to the broth with a garlic soffritto, on toasted bread with pecorino.
