Friggerli nell'olio di semi a 175 °C per: Fry them in the seed oil at 175 °C for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden, and drain them on kitchen paper.
Tritare la cipolla con l'aglio e il pepe: Chop the onion with the garlic and chilli.
In una casseruola di terracotta scaldare: In an earthenware casserole heat the extra virgin oil and brown the battuto over a medium heat for 5 minutes.
Versare il vino bianco e l'acqua, poi ad: Pour in the white wine and the water, then lay in the fried salt cod.
Lasciar ridurre il liquido piano, a fuoc: Let the liquid reduce gently, over a low heat, for about 15 minutes, shaking the casserole.
Unire le bietole e le foglie di maggiora: Add the chard and the marjoram leaves, boil for another 5 minutes and adjust the salt.
Servire caldo; si conserva un giorno in: Serve hot; it keeps for a day in the fridge.
Piatto della tradizione della provincia: A traditional dish of the province of Massa Carrara, «bacalà 'nmarinat»: a simple, tasty way of cooking a humble fish.
C'è chi aggiunge qualche pomodoro nel ba: Some add a few tomatoes to the battuto.
Accendere il forno a 190 °C in modalità: Heat the oven to 190 °C on the grill setting.
Togliere la salsiccia dal budello e sbri: Remove the sausage from its casing and crumble it into a bowl.
Unire lo stracchino e mescolare con una: Add the stracchino and mix with a fork into an even cream.
Tagliare a metà le fette di pane caserec: Cut the slices of country bread in half and spread them with the mixture, right to the edges.
Disporle su una teglia e cuocere circa 1: Arrange them on a baking tray and bake for about 15 minutes on the middle shelf, until the sausage is cooked.
Negli ultimi 2 minuti avvicinarle al gri: For the last 2 minutes move them close to the grill to brown them well.
Servirli caldi come antipasto; non si co: Serve them hot as an antipasto; they do not keep.
Antipasto della tradizione maremmana, co: A traditional Maremma antipasto, with the stracchino of the Sorano hinterland; it is served with the other Tuscan antipasti.
Crespelle: sbattere le 3 uova con la far: Crêpes: beat the 3 eggs with the flour and a pinch of salt, removing the lumps, then add the milk a little at a time with the whisk; cover and put in the fridge for 1 hour.
Ripieno: tritare gli spinaci cotti e ben: Filling: chop the cooked, well-squeezed spinach and mix it with the ricotta, parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg, salt and the beaten egg.
Scaldare a fuoco medio una padella antia: Heat a 20 cm non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and grease it with a little oil using kitchen paper.
Versare un velo di pastella, cuocere 2-3: Pour in a thin layer of batter, cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges are golden, turn and cook for another minute: it makes 8.
Besciamella: sciogliere il burro a fuoco: Béchamel: melt the butter over a medium heat, add the flour and toast it for 2 minutes, pour in the cold milk a little at a time, stirring, and cook over a medium-low heat for 8 minutes, until it coats the spoon; season with salt and nutmeg.
Accendere il forno statico a 200 °C. Far: Heat a conventional oven to 200 °C. Fill each crêpe with the filling and fold it in four like a handkerchief.
Disporle un po' sovrapposte in una tegli: Arrange them slightly overlapping in a baking dish with a few spoonfuls of béchamel, cover them with the remaining béchamel, the tomato passata, the parmesan and a drizzle of oil.
Abbassare il forno a 180 °C e cuocere ci: Lower the oven to 180 °C and bake for about 20 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Servirle calde; si conservano 2 giorni i: Serve them hot; they keep for 2 days in the fridge and are reheated with a drop of milk.
Piatto legato alla leggenda di Caterina: A dish linked to the legend of Catherine de' Medici and the dispute between Florentine and French cooking; folded like handkerchiefs they are also called «pezzole della nonna» (grandmother's handkerchiefs). Nutmeg was one of Catherine's favourite flavours.
Si piegano anche a cannellone, arrotolat: They are also rolled up like cannelloni.
Sfoglia: impastare la farina con le uova: Pasta: knead the flour with the eggs, yolks, oil, a pinch of salt and the lukewarm water for 10 minutes, into a soft dough; wrap it and leave it to rest for an hour.
Ripieno: cuocere in padella con un filo: Filling: cook the minced meat, chicken breast and small pork steaks in a frying pan with a drizzle of oil, over a medium heat for 15-20 minutes, until well cooked; leave them to cool.
Ammollare il pane raffermo nel latte e s: Soak the stale bread in the milk and squeeze it.
Tritare finemente le carni con la mortad: Finely chop the meats with the mortadella and add the 2 eggs, the parmesan, the chopped parsley and garlic, the bread and a pinch of salt; mix well.
Stendere la sfoglia sottile e tagliarla: Roll the pasta out thin and cut it into strips 10 cm wide; put hazelnut-sized balls of filling in the middle, 5 cm apart.
Ripiegare la sfoglia e ritagliare con un: Fold the pasta over and cut out half-moons with a 7 cm round cutter, pressing the edges well.
Lasciarle riposare almeno un giorno su u: Leave them to rest for at least a day on a floured tray, covered, in the fridge.
Lessare i tordelli in acqua salata a bol: Boil the tordelli in boiling salted water for 4-5 minutes and drain them when they rise to the surface.
Scaldare il ragù di carne pronto e condi: Heat the ready-made meat ragù and dress the tordelli generously with the ragù and parmesan; raw, they keep for a month in the freezer.
Pasta ripiena dei giorni di festa in Ver: The filled pasta of feast days in Versilia (Seravezza, Camaiore, Pietrasanta, Viareggio, Forte dei Marmi, Massarosa): every family has its own variant, with a robust country flavour.
Rispetto ai tordelli lucchesi il ripieno: Compared with Lucca tordelli the filling has more white meat and mortadella.
Sbattere le uova con un pizzico di sale: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and a few drops of the lemon juice.
Tagliare il pollo a pezzi piccoli, disos: Cut the chicken into small pieces, boning the larger ones; wash and dry them well.
Passare i pezzi di pollo in 50 g di fari: Dip the chicken pieces in 50 g of flour, then in the egg and finally in the breadcrumbs, pressing well; set them aside.
Pulire i carciofi togliendo le foglie du: Clean the artichokes, removing the tough leaves, and cut them into wedges; cut the courgettes into sticks and the potatoes into 5 mm slices; remove the stalk and pistil from the courgette flowers.
Preparare la pastella con la farina rima: Make the batter with the remaining flour and very cold water, stirring into a smooth cream that is not too runny.
Scaldare l'olio a 170 °C e friggere il p: Heat the oil to 170 °C and fry the chicken, a few pieces at a time, for 8-10 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Cambiare l'olio, portarlo a 180 °C e fri: Change the oil, bring it to 180 °C and fry the vegetables dipped in the batter, 3-4 minutes, until crisp.
Scolare tutto su carta assorbente, salar: Drain everything on kitchen paper, salt after a few minutes so that it stays crisp and serve at once, hot.
Il fritto misto fiorentino un tempo avev: The Florentine fritto misto once had sweetbreads, lamb cutlets, brains, spinal marrow and livers; today it is made with chicken or rabbit and vegetables. In Florence they say «fritta è buona anche una ciabatta» (fried, even a slipper is good).
Con il coniglio al posto del pollo; in p: With rabbit instead of chicken; in spring with artichokes, in summer with courgettes and flowers.
Per il brodo di cappone: mettere mezzo c: For the capon broth: put half a capon (or a piece of beef or hen) in 3 litres of cold water with an onion, a carrot and a celery stick, salt and cook over a very low heat for 3 hours; strain it.
Cuocere la lonza di maiale e il petto di: Cook the pork loin and chicken breast in a pan with a little broth for 20 minutes; mince them finely with the mortadella.
In una terrina amalgamare la carne macin: In a bowl blend the minced meat with the stracchino, Parmigiano, 1 egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper: the filling must be firm, and if the stracchino is watery add more Parmigiano.
Impastare la farina con 4 uova e un pizz: Knead the flour with 4 eggs and a pinch of salt, roll out a thin sheet and cut it into 3-4 cm squares.
Mettere mezzo cucchiaino di ripieno su o: Put half a teaspoon of filling on each square, join two opposite corners into a triangle, seal the edges and bring the tips together around your finger to form the little hat.
Cuocerli nel brodo di cappone bollente 3: Cook them in boiling capon broth for 3-4 minutes, until they float, and serve them in their broth.
Il Comune di Palazzuolo sul Senio li rip: The Comune of Palazzuolo sul Senio includes them among the recipes of the cooking “dei sapori antichi della Romagna fiorentina” (of the old flavours of Florentine Romagna), dedicated to grandmothers and mothers: pasta with 9 eggs per kilo of flour (half here), a filling of stracchino, Parmigiano, pork loin, chicken and mortadella, cooked in beef, capon or hen broth.
Served without broth, with meat ragù.
La sera prima, verso l'ora di cena, mesc: The evening before, around dinner time, whisk the bread flour, the yeast and the warm water together in a large bowl.
Coprire e lasciare a temperatura ambient: Cover and leave at room temperature for at least 12 hours, until it is full of bubbles.
Il giorno dopo versare il preimpasto in: The next day tip the starter into a large bowl, add the 00 flour, the water and the salt and knead into a soft, sticky dough; pour a trickle of oil around the ball.
Coprire con un canovaccio umido e lascia: Cover with a damp tea towel and leave to rise for at least 2 hours, until doubled, giving it a series of folds every 30 minutes.
Ungere bene una teglia larga, stendere l: Oil a wide tin well, spread the dough out gently, let it relax and then stretch it to the edges; leave to rise for about another 2 hours.
Accendere il forno a 200 °C, irrorare la: Heat the oven to 200 °C, drizzle the surface with more oil, sprinkle with salt and bake for 20-25 minutes, until golden.
Visit Tuscany, il sito del turismo della: Visit Tuscany, the Region of Tuscany's tourism site, presents schiacciata as the queen of Tuscan baking, good at any hour, as an aperitivo, a snack or street food: some like it soft, salty and oily, others thin and crisp. The quantities are those published on the site, from Juls' Kitchen's recipe. Quantities are estimated for the ingredients the source gives as “to taste” (extra virgin olive oil).
Più sottile e croccante: si stende in du: Thinner and crisper: spread it in two tins and bake for a few minutes longer.
Per la spuma (l'agar agar si trova al su: For the foam (agar-agar is sold in supermarkets, near the baking ingredients and gelatine): bring the grapefruit juice to the boil in a small pan with the agar-agar and simmer for 4 minutes; leave it to cool until set, then whisk it with an electric whisk to a frothy sauce.
Sbucciare il pompelmo con il coltello to: Peel the grapefruit with a knife, taking off the white pith as well, slice it and leave it in the extra virgin olive oil with a pinch of salt.
Togliere ai finocchi i gambi e le foglie: Trim the fennel of its stalks and outer leaves, cut it into wedges and keep them in iced water.
Portare a bollore l'acqua con lo zuccher: Bring the water to the boil with the sugar, add the white wine vinegar, star anise and a sprig of thyme, bring back to the boil, add the fennel wedges and simmer for 10 minutes; turn off the heat and leave them in the liquid.
Spellare i filetti di San Pietro e divid: Skin the John Dory fillets and divide them into portions of about 150 g.
Scaldare bene una padella con il burro c: Heat a frying pan well with the clarified butter (or ordinary butter with a spoonful of oil, which burns less easily), the remaining thyme and the crushed garlic clove, and sear the fish over a high heat for 1-2 minutes a side.
Salare con il sale in fiocchi e servire: Season with flaky salt and serve with the fennel wedges, grapefruit slices and foam.
La ricetta è di Gaetano Trovato, lo chef: The recipe is by Gaetano Trovato, chef of the Arnolfo restaurant in Colle di Val d'Elsa, and Falstaff Italia publishes it as an example of how fennel, with its southern flavour, can give character to a fish dish. The ingredients and quantities are those of the recipe published by Falstaff; the method has been rewritten here.
Con l'arancia al posto del pompelmo; con: With orange instead of grapefruit; topped with wild fennel seeds and fronds.
Cuocere la passata di pomodoro in un teg: Cook the tomato passata in a wide pan with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes, until it thickens.
Tagliare il burro freddissimo a cubetti: Cut the very cold butter into cubes and keep it in the fridge.
Cuocere le penne lisce in acqua salata e: Cook the smooth penne in salted water and drain them very al dente, keeping a ladleful of cooking water.
Versarle nel sugo, fuori dal fuoco, e un: Add them to the sauce, off the heat, and add the butter cubes a little at a time, stirring, until the sauce becomes creamy.
Unire il parmigiano grattugiato e un po': Add the grated parmesan and a little cooking water, stirring again.
Servirle con il basilico fresco spezzato: Serve them with torn fresh basil and a grinding of black pepper.
Sono le penne del ristorante Maitò di Fo: They are the penne of the Maitò restaurant in Forte dei Marmi, in Versilia, which became famous among American film people; GialloZafferano gives them with the restaurant's quantities, with plenty of butter. Ingredients and quantities are those of the GialloZafferano page; the method is rewritten here, in more detail.
With half the butter; with mozzarella.
